# Data Lakehouse Architecture – Pipeline & Governance

## Overview
This dataset describes a modern data lakehouse architecture following the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold). It captures 10 data sources across 5 categories, 3 ingestion modes, 5 medallion-layer datasets per tier, 6 consumption endpoints, 15 governance controls, and transformation summaries per layer.

## Data Source

### architecture_nodes
Each record represents a component in the architecture. Fields: `node_id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (display name), `layer` (one of: source, ingestion, bronze, silver, gold, consumption), `category` (grouping within layer), `daily_volume_gb` (numeric or null for consumption nodes), `format` (data format or technology). 34 nodes total.

### architecture_edges
Directed edges between nodes. Fields: `edge_id` (string), `source` and `target` (node_id references), `volume_gb` (numeric or null), `mode` (streaming | batch | cdc | query), `latency` (descriptive string). 38 edges total.

### governance_controls
Governance policies applied per layer. Fields: `control_id`, `layer` (architecture layer or cross-layer), `control_type`, `tool`, `scope`, `enforcement` (automated | policy-based | manual | scheduled). 15 records.

### transformation_summary
Counts of transformation types per medallion layer. Fields: `layer`, `transformation_type`, `count` (integer), `complexity` (low | medium | high). 12 records across bronze, silver, and gold.

## Data Notes
- Volume figures are illustrative daily averages; actual volumes vary by day.
- Some bronze volumes exceed source totals due to log fan-out and metadata enrichment.
- Consumption-layer nodes have null volume as they represent query-based access.
- Governance controls tagged as "cross-layer" apply to the entire pipeline.

It captures 10 data sources across 5 categories, 3 ingestion modes, 5 medallion-layer datasets per tier, 6 consumption endpoints, 15 governance controls, and transformation summaries per layer.

## Data Source

### architecture_nodes
Each record represents a component in the architecture. Fields: `node_id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (display name), `layer` (one of: source, ingestion, bronze, silver, gold, consumption), `category` (grouping within layer), `daily_volume_gb` (numeric or null for consumption nodes), `format` (data format or technology). 34 nodes total.

Directed edges between nodes. Fields: `edge_id` (string), `source` and `target` (node_id references), `volume_gb` (numeric or null), `mode` (streaming | batch | cdc | query), `latency` (descriptive string). 38 edges total.

### governance_controls

### transformation_summary

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Data Lakehouse Architecture: Sankey diagram with governance & transformation overlays.""" import plotly.graph_objects as go from plotly.subplots import make_subplots import json # ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f: data = json.load(f) nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"] edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"] governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"] transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"] # ── Node index mapping ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── node_ids = [n["node_id"] for n in nodes_data] id_to_idx = {nid: i for i, nid in enumerate(node_ids)} # ── Layer x-positions for Sankey ─────────────────────────────────────────── layer_x = { "source": 0.01, "ingestion": 0.20, "bronze": 0.38, "silver": 0.56, "gold": 0.74, "consumption": 0.93, } # ── Color palettes (business/analyst professional) ───────────────────────── # Source categories → distinct professional blues/teals/greens category_colors = { "IoT/Streaming": "#2B6B8F", "Enterprise Apps": "#3A7CA5", "Logs/Clickstream": "#1E5A78", "External/3rd Party": "#5B9BB5", "Databases": "#4682A0", } layer_fill = { "ingestion": "#708090", "bronze": "#CD7F32", "silver": "#A8B8C8", "gold": "#DAA520", "consumption": "#2E7D56", } consumption_colors = { "BI": "#2E7D32", "ML": "#7B4173", "API": "#2B6B8F", "Reverse ETL": "#DAA520", } # ── Build node colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── node_colors = [] for n in nodes_data: if n["layer"] == "source": node_colors.append(category_colors.get(n["category"], "#6B8E9B")) elif n["layer"] in layer_fill: if n["layer"] == "consumption": node_colors.append(consumption_colors.get(n["category"], layer_fill[n["layer"]])) else: node_colors.append(layer_fill[n["layer"]]) else: node_colors.append("#999999") # ── Node labels (with volume annotations for non-consumption) ────────────── node_labels = [] for n in nodes_data: label = n["label"] if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None: label += f" ({n['daily_volume_gb']} GB)" node_labels.append(label) # │  LEGEND: ■ IoT/Streaming ■ Enterprise ■ Logs ■ External ...  │
```
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

Let me code this up properly. I'll use thick bezier curves for edges and rounded rectangles for nodes.

Actually, drawing all 38 edges with thick lines will result in a lot of visual overlap. Let me use transparency and z-ordering to handle this. I'll draw larger flows on top with lower opacity.

Wait, actually, for a Sankey-style diagram, the key insight is that edges START at specific vertical positions on the right side of the source node and END at specific vertical positions on the left side of the target node. The vertical offset within each node determines where the edge connects, and all edges to/from a node are stacked.

For simplicity and alignment, I could use a different approach: instead of trying to draw a perfect Sankey, I can create a more schematic flow diagram where:
1. Nodes are rectangles arranged in columns
2. Edges are simple curves connecting node centers
3. Line widths encode volume

This is simpler to implement and still conveys the insight effectively.

Let me code this up. I'll be careful about:
- Node positions (x by layer, y by manual arrangement)
- Edge curves (Bezier paths)
- Edge widths (sqrt-scaled volume)
- Edge colors (by source category)
- Governance text annotations
- Transformation badges

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture: Sankey-style flow diagram with governance & transformation overlays."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

# ── Color palettes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
category_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#2B6B8F",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#3A7CA5",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#1E5A78",
    "External/3rd Party": "#5B9BB5",
    "Databases":          "#4682A0",
}

layer_colors = {
    "source":       "#3A7CA5",
    "ingestion":    "#708090",
    "bronze":       "#CD7F32",
    "silver":       "#A8B8C8",
    "gold":         "#DAA520",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}

consumption_colors = {
    "BI":          "#2E7D32",
    "ML":          "#7B4173",
    "API":         "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL": "#DAA520",
}

gov_enforcement_colors = {
    "automated":    "#2E7D32",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#C0392B",
    "scheduled":    "#2980B9",
}

edge_mode_colors = {
    "streaming": "#2E7D32",
    "batch":     "#E67E22",
    "cdc":       "#8E44AD",
    "query":     "#999999",
}

edge_mode_zorder = {
    "streaming": 4,
    "cdc": 3,
    "batch": 2,
    "query": 1,
}

# ── Node index mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node_ids = [n["node_id"] for n in nodes_data]
id_to_idx = {nid: i for i, nid in enumerate(node_ids)}
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Layer x-positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_x = {
    "source":       0.05,
    "ingestion":    0.22,
    "bronze":       0.39,
    "silver":       0.56,
    "gold":         0.73,
    "consumption":  0.90,
}

# ── Node y-positions (manual arrangement to minimize crossings) ────────────
# Arrange nodes within each layer, top to bottom
layer_nodes = {ly: [] for ly in layer_x}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer_nodes[n["layer"]].append(n)

# Sort within each layer for visual clarity
source_order = [
    "src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream", "src_nosql",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_crm", "src_social", "src_files", "src_market"
]
ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

# Compute y-positions
y_positions = {}
total_height = 1.0
y_top = 0.93
y_bottom = 0.07
available_height = y_top - y_bottom

for ly in ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n_nodes = len(order)
    if n_nodes == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = available_height / (n_nodes - 1)
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_top - i * spacing

# ── Helper: hex to rgba ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hex_to_rgba(hex_color, alpha):
    h = hex_color.lstrip("#")
    r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
    return (r/255, g/255, b/255, alpha)

# ── Node color lookup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return category_colors.get(n["category"], "#6B8E9B")
    elif n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return consumption_colors.get(n["category"], layer_colors[n["layer"]])
    else:
        return layer_colors.get(n["layer"], "#999999")

# ── Figure setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 16), facecolor="#FAFBFC")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.02, 0.06, 0.96, 0.85])  # Leave room for titles and legends
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.axis("off")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (thick curved lines, volume-weighted)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Collect volumes for scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vmin, vmax = min(all_vols), max(all_vols)

def vol_to_lw(vol):
    """Map volume to linewidth using sqrt scale."""
    if vol is None or vol <= 0:
        return 1.2
    # sqrt scale for better differentiation of medium volumes
    normalized = np.sqrt(vol / vmax)
    return 1.0 + normalized * 22.0

def draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, color, alpha=0.55, zorder=2):
    """Draw a cubic bezier curve between two points."""
    # Control points for smooth S-curve
    cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y0)
    cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y1)

    verts = [
        (x0, y0),
        cp1,
        cp2,
        (x1, y1),
    ]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)

    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                                linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder,
                                capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Sort edges: draw smaller ones first (they'll be behind)
edges_sorted = sorted(edges_data, key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

for e in edges_sorted:
    src_id = e["source"]
    tgt_id = e["target"]
    src_node = id_to_node[src_id]
    tgt_node = id_to_node[tgt_id]

    x0 = layer_x[src_node["layer"]] + 0.04
    y0 = y_positions[src_id]
    x1 = layer_x[tgt_node["layer"]] - 0.01
    y1 = y_positions[tgt_id]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] is not None else 0.5
    lw = vol_to_lw(vol)

    mode = e["mode"]
    edge_color = edge_mode_colors.get(mode, "#999")
    zorder = edge_mode_zorder.get(mode, 1)

    draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, edge_color, alpha=0.50, zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES (rounded rectangles)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

node_w = 0.035
node_h = 0.026

for n in nodes_data:
    x_center = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_center = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_center - node_w/2
    y0 = y_center - node_h/2

    color = get_node_color(n)

    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
        facecolor=color,
        edgecolor="white",
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=10,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    label_text = n["label"]
    # Truncate long labels
    if len(label_text) > 15:
        label_text = label_text[:14] + "…"

    # Volume annotation
    vol_text = ""
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        vol_text = f"\n{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB"

    ax.text(x_center, y_center, label_text + vol_text,
            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=5.5, fontweight="bold",
            color="white", zorder=11,
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.0, foreground="#333")])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
layer_labels = [
    ("DATA SOURCES", 0.05, "#3A7CA5"),
    ("INGESTION", 0.22, "#708090"),
    ("BRONZE (Raw)", 0.39, "#CD7F32"),
    ("SILVER (Curated)", 0.56, "#A8B8C8"),
    ("GOLD (Business)", 0.73, "#DAA520"),
    ("CONSUMPTION", 0.90, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, color in layer_labels:
    ax.text(xpos, 0.985, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold", color=color, family="monospace")
    # Underline bar
    ax.plot([xpos - 0.03, xpos + 0.03], [0.978, 0.978],
            color=color, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle="round", transform=ax.transData)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE OVERLAY (colored bars with annotations)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Governance bars above layers
gov_layer_info = {}
for g in governance:
    ly = g["layer"]
    if ly not in gov_layer_info:
        gov_layer_info[ly] = []
    gov_layer_info[ly].append(g)

# Draw governance indicator bars at top of each layer
for ly, xpos in [("ingestion", 0.22), ("bronze", 0.39), ("silver", 0.56),
                  ("gold", 0.73), ("consumption", 0.90)]:
    if ly in gov_layer_info:
        # Count enforcement types
        enf_counts = {}
        for g in gov_layer_info[ly]:
            enf_counts[g["enforcement"]] = enf_counts.get(g["enforcement"], 0) + 1

        # Draw stacked bar segments
        bar_y = 0.965
        bar_h = 0.008
        total = sum(enf_counts.values())
        seg_x = xpos - 0.03
        seg_w = 0.06 / total if total > 0 else 0.06

        for enf, count in sorted(enf_counts.items()):
            for _ in range(count):
                ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
                    (seg_x, bar_y), seg_w, bar_h,
                    boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",
                    facecolor=gov_enforcement_colors.get(enf, "#999"),
                    edgecolor="none", alpha=0.85, zorder=15,
                ))
                seg_x += seg_w

# Governance text annotations below the sankey
gov_text_lines = []
gov_by_layer_ordered = ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption", "cross-layer"]

gov_summary_y = 0.045
for i, ly in enumerate(gov_by_layer_ordered):
    if ly not in gov_layer_info:
        continue
    controls = gov_layer_info[ly]
    control_names = [g["control_type"] for g in controls]
    tools = [g["tool"] for g in controls]

    ly_name = {"ingestion": "INGEST", "bronze": "BRONZE", "silver": "SILVER",
               "gold": "GOLD", "consumption": "CONS", "cross-layer": "CROSS"}[ly]

    text = f"{ly_name}: " + " | ".join(control_names)
    gov_text_lines.append(text)

gov_full_text = "GOVERNANCE CONTROLS — " + "  ◆  ".join(gov_text_lines)
ax.text(0.50, gov_summary_y, gov_full_text, ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=5.5, color="#555", family="monospace",
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="#F0F0F0",
                  edgecolor="#DDD", alpha=0.9))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSFORMATION BADGES (on medallion layers)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

transform_by_layer = {}
for t in transforms:
    ly = t["layer"]
    if ly not in transform_by_layer:
        transform_by_layer[ly] = {"total": 0, "high": 0, "medium": 0, "low": 0, "types": []}
    transform_by_layer[ly]["total"] += t["count"]
    transform_by_layer[ly][t["complexity"]] += t["count"]
    transform_by_layer[ly]["types"].append(t["transformation_type"])

for ly in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    if ly not in transform_by_layer:
        continue
    info = transform_by_layer[ly]
    xpos = layer_x[ly]
    ypos = 0.03

    tf_text = (f"⚙ {info['total']} transforms\n"
               f"└ L:{info['low']} M:{info['medium']} H:{info['high']}")

    ax.text(xpos, ypos, tf_text, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=5.2,
            color="#444", family="monospace", zorder=20,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="white",
                      edgecolor="#CCC", alpha=0.9))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

legend_y = 0.005
legend_items = []

# Source categories
for cat, col in category_colors.items():
    legend_items.append((col, cat, "Source"))
# Medallion
for ly_name, col in [("Bronze", "#CD7F32"), ("Silver", "#A8B8C8"), ("Gold", "#DAA520")]:
    legend_items.append((col, f"{ly_name} Layer", "Medallion"))
# Consumption types
for cat, col in consumption_colors.items():
    legend_items.append((col, cat, "Consumption"))
# Edge modes
for mode, col in edge_mode_colors.items():
    legend_items.append((col, mode.capitalize(), "Edge"))

# Draw legend as a row of colored circles with labels
n_legend = len(legend_items)
spacing = 0.95 / n_legend
for i, (col, label, grp) in enumerate(legend_items):
    lx = 0.025 + i * spacing
    # Color swatch
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (lx, legend_y), 0.008, 0.008,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",
        facecolor=col, edgecolor="none", zorder=20,
        transform=ax.transData,
    ))
    ax.text(lx + 0.010, legend_y + 0.004, label, fontsize=4.8,
            color="#555", va="center", transform=ax.transData)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline & Governance",
             fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color="#222", y=0.985, x=0.5)

fig.text(0.5, 0.968,
         "Volume-Weighted Data Flow: 10 Sources → 3 Ingestion Modes → 15 Medallion Datasets → 6 Consumption Endpoints | "
         "15 Governance Controls Across All Layers",
         ha="center", fontsize=8, color="#666", style="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VOLUME SCALE INDICATOR
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Show reference line widths
scale_x = 0.93
scale_vols = [530, 200, 50, 5]
for i, (sv, label) in enumerate([(530, "530 GB"), (200, "200 GB"), (50, "50 GB"), (5, "5 GB")]):
    sy = 0.28 + i * 0.06
    slw = vol_to_lw(label.split()[0] if i == 0 else 200 if i == 1 else 50 if i == 2 else 5) / vol_to_lw(530) * 0.04
    ax.plot([scale_x, scale_x + 0.025], [sy, sy], color="#777", linewidth=vol_to_lw(
        530 if i == 0 else 200 if i == 1 else 50 if i == 2 else 5),
            alpha=0.7, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.text(scale_x + 0.028, sy, f"≈{label}", fontsize=5, color="#777", va="center")

ax.text(scale_x + 0.014, 0.50, "Flow\nVolume", fontsize=5.5, color="#999",
        ha="center", va="bottom", fontweight="bold")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, facecolor="#FAFBFC",
            edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

ax.set_xlim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.axis("off")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (thick curved lines, volume-weighted)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Collect volumes for scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vmin, vmax = min(all_vols), max(all_vols)

def vol_to_lw(vol):
    """Map volume to linewidth using sqrt scale."""
    if vol is None or vol <= 0:
        return 1.2
    # sqrt scale for better differentiation of medium volumes
    normalized = np.sqrt(vol / vmax)
    return 1.0 + normalized * 22.0

def draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, color, alpha=0.55, zorder=2):
    """Draw a cubic bezier curve between two points."""
    # Control points for smooth S-curve
    cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y0)
    cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y1)

    verts = [
        (x0, y0),
        cp1,
        cp2,
        (x1, y1),
    ]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)

    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                                linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder,
                                capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Sort edges: draw smaller ones first (they'll be behind)
edges_sorted = sorted(edges_data, key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

for e in edges_sorted:
    src_id = e["source"]
    tgt_id = e["target"]
    src_node = id_to_node[src_id]
    tgt_node = id_to_node[tgt_id]

    x0 = layer_x[src_node["layer"]] + 0.04
    y0 = y_positions[src_id]
    x1 = layer_x[tgt_node["layer"]] - 0.01
    y1 = y_positions[tgt_id]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] is not None else 0.5
    lw = vol_to_lw(vol)

    mode = e["mode"]
    edge_color = edge_mode_colors.get(mode, "#999")
    zorder = edge_mode_zorder.get(mode, 1)

    draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, edge_color, alpha=0.50, zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES (rounded rectangles)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

node_w = 0.035
node_h = 0.026

for n in nodes_data:
    x_center = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_center = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_center - node_w/2
    y0 = y_center - node_h/2

    color = get_node_color(n)

    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
        facecolor=color,
        edgecolor="white",
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=10,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    label_text = n["label"]
    # Truncate long labels
    if len(label_text) > 15:
        label_text = label_text[:14] + "…"

    # Volume annotation
    vol_text = ""
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        vol_text = f"\n{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB"

    ax.text(x_center, y_center, label_text + vol_text,
            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=5.5, fontweight="bold",
            color="white", zorder=11,
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.0, foreground="#333")])

    ("BRONZE (Raw)", 0.39, "#CD7F32"),
    ("SILVER (Curated)", 0.56, "#A8B8C8"),
    ("GOLD (Business)", 0.73, "#DAA520"),
    ("CONSUMPTION", 0.90, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, color in layer_labels:
    ax.text(xpos, 0.985, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold", color=color, family="monospace")
    # Underline bar
    ax.plot([xpos - 0.03, xpos + 0.03], [0.978, 0.978],
            color=color, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle="round", transform=ax.transData)

# Governance bars above layers
gov_layer_info = {}
for g in governance:

    if ly not in gov_layer_info:
        gov_layer_info[ly] = []
    gov_layer_info[ly].append(g)

# Draw governance indicator bars at top of each layer
for ly, xpos in [("ingestion", 0.22), ("bronze", 0.39), ("silver", 0.56),

    if ly in gov_layer_info:
        # Count enforcement types
        enf_counts = {}
        for g in gov_layer_info[ly]:
            enf_counts[g["enforcement"]] = enf_counts.get(g["enforcement"], 0) + 1

        # Draw stacked bar segments
        bar_y = 0.965
        bar_h = 0.008
        total = sum(enf_counts.values())
        seg_x = xpos - 0.03
        seg_w = 0.06 / total if total > 0 else 0.06

        for enf, count in sorted(enf_counts.items()):
            for _ in range(count):
                ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(

                    boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",
                    facecolor=gov_enforcement_colors.get(enf, "#999"),
                    edgecolor="none", alpha=0.85, zorder=15,
                ))
                seg_x += seg_w

# Governance text annotations below the sankey
gov_text_lines = []
gov_by_layer_ordered = ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption", "cross-layer"]

gov_summary_y = 0.045
for i, ly in enumerate(gov_by_layer_ordered):
    if ly not in gov_layer_info:

    controls = gov_layer_info[ly]
    control_names = [g["control_type"] for g in controls]
    tools = [g["tool"] for g in controls]

    ly_name = {"ingestion": "INGEST", "bronze": "BRONZE", "silver": "SILVER",
               "gold": "GOLD", "consumption": "CONS", "cross-layer": "CROSS"}[ly]

    text = f"{ly_name}: " + " | ".join(control_names)
    gov_text_lines.append(text)

gov_full_text = "GOVERNANCE CONTROLS — " + "  ◆  ".join(gov_text_lines)
ax.text(0.50, gov_summary_y, gov_full_text, ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=5.5, color="#555", family="monospace",

                  edgecolor="#DDD", alpha=0.9))

n_legend = len(legend_items)
spacing = 0.95 / n_legend
for i, (col, label, grp) in enumerate(legend_items):
    lx = 0.025 + i * spacing
    # Color swatch
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(

        boxstyle="round,pad=0.001",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture: Sankey-style flow diagram with governance & transformation overlays."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

# ── Color palettes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
category_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#2B6B8F",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#3A7CA5",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#1E5A78",
    "External/3rd Party": "#5B9BB5",
    "Databases":          "#4682A0",
}

layer_colors = {
    "source":       "#3A7CA5",
    "ingestion":    "#708090",
    "bronze":       "#CD7F32",
    "silver":       "#A8B8C8",
    "gold":         "#DAA520",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}

consumption_colors = {
    "BI":          "#2E7D32",
    "ML":          "#7B4173",
    "API":         "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL": "#DAA520",
}

gov_enforcement_colors = {
    "automated":    "#2E7D32",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#C0392B",
    "scheduled":    "#2980B9",
}

edge_mode_colors = {
    "streaming": "#2E7D32",
    "batch":     "#E67E22",
    "cdc":       "#8E44AD",
    "query":     "#999999",
}

edge_mode_zorder = {
    "streaming": 4,
    "cdc": 3,
    "batch": 2,
    "query": 1,
}

# ── Node index mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node_ids = [n["node_id"] for n in nodes_data]
id_to_idx = {nid: i for i, nid in enumerate(node_ids)}
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Layer x-positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_x = {
    "source":       0.05,
    "ingestion":    0.22,
    "bronze":       0.39,
    "silver":       0.56,
    "gold":         0.73,
    "consumption":  0.90,
}

# ── Node y-positions (manual arrangement to minimize crossings) ────────────
# Arrange nodes within each layer, top to bottom
layer_nodes = {ly: [] for ly in layer_x}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer_nodes[n["layer"]].append(n)

# Sort within each layer for visual clarity
source_order = [
    "src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream", "src_nosql",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_crm", "src_social", "src_files", "src_market"
]
ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

# Compute y-positions
y_positions = {}
total_height = 1.0
y_top = 0.93
y_bottom = 0.07
available_height = y_top - y_bottom

for ly in ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n_nodes = len(order)
    if n_nodes == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = available_height / (n_nodes - 1)
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_top - i * spacing

# ── Helper: hex to rgba ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hex_to_rgba(hex_color, alpha):
    h = hex_color.lstrip("#")
    r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
    return (r/255, g/255, b/255, alpha)

# ── Node color lookup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return category_colors.get(n["category"], "#6B8E9B")
    elif n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return consumption_colors.get(n["category"], layer_colors[n["layer"]])
    else:
        return layer_colors.get(n["layer"], "#999999")

# ── Figure setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 16), facecolor="#FAFBFC")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.02, 0.06, 0.96, 0.85])  # Leave room for titles and legends
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.axis("off")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (thick curved lines, volume-weighted)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Collect volumes for scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vmin, vmax = min(all_vols), max(all_vols)

def vol_to_lw(vol):
    """Map volume to linewidth using sqrt scale."""
    if vol is None or vol <= 0:
        return 1.2
    # sqrt scale for better differentiation of medium volumes
    normalized = np.sqrt(vol / vmax)
    return 1.0 + normalized * 22.0

def draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, color, alpha=0.55, zorder=2):
    """Draw a cubic bezier curve between two points."""
    # Control points for smooth S-curve
    cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y0)
    cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y1)

    verts = [
        (x0, y0),
        cp1,
        cp2,
        (x1, y1),
    ]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture: Sankey-style flow diagram with governance & transformation overlays."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

# ── Color palettes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
category_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#2B6B8F",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#3A7CA5",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#1E5A78",
    "External/3rd Party": "#5B9BB5",
    "Databases":          "#4682A0",
}

layer_colors = {
    "source":       "#3A7CA5",
    "ingestion":    "#708090",
    "bronze":       "#CD7F32",
    "silver":       "#A8B8C8",
    "gold":         "#DAA520",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}

consumption_colors = {
    "BI":          "#2E7D32",
    "ML":          "#7B4173",
    "API":         "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL": "#DAA520",
}

gov_enforcement_colors = {
    "automated":    "#2E7D32",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#C0392B",
    "scheduled":    "#2980B9",
}

edge_mode_colors = {
    "streaming": "#2E7D32",
    "batch":     "#E67E22",
    "cdc":       "#8E44AD",
    "query":     "#999999",
}

edge_mode_zorder = {
    "streaming": 4,
    "cdc": 3,
    "batch": 2,
    "query": 1,
}

# ── Node index mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node_ids = [n["node_id"] for n in nodes_data]
id_to_idx = {nid: i for i, nid in enumerate(node_ids)}
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Layer x-positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_x = {
    "source":       0.05,
    "ingestion":    0.22,
    "bronze":       0.39,
    "silver":       0.56,
    "gold":         0.73,
    "consumption":  0.90,
}

# ── Node y-positions (manual arrangement to minimize crossings) ────────────
# Arrange nodes within each layer, top to bottom
layer_nodes = {ly: [] for ly in layer_x}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer_nodes[n["layer"]].append(n)

# Sort within each layer for visual clarity
source_order = [
    "src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream", "src_nosql",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_crm", "src_social", "src_files", "src_market"
]
ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

# Compute y-positions
y_positions = {}
total_height = 1.0
y_top = 0.93
y_bottom = 0.07
available_height = y_top - y_bottom

for ly in ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n_nodes = len(order)
    if n_nodes == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = available_height / (n_nodes - 1)
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_top - i * spacing

# ── Helper: hex to rgba ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hex_to_rgba(hex_color, alpha):
    h = hex_color.lstrip("#")
    r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
    return (r/255, g/255, b/255, alpha)

# ── Node color lookup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return category_colors.get(n["category"], "#6B8E9B")
    elif n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return consumption_colors.get(n["category"], layer_colors[n["layer"]])
    else:
        return layer_colors.get(n["layer"], "#999999")

# ── Figure setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ax = fig.add_axes([0.02, 0.06, 0.96, 0.85])  # Leave room for titles and legends
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.axis("off")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Collect volumes for scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vmin, vmax = min(all_vols), max(all_vols)

def vol_to_lw(vol):
    """Map volume to linewidth using sqrt scale."""
    if vol is None or vol <= 0:
        return 1.2
    # sqrt scale for better differentiation of medium volumes
    normalized = np.sqrt(vol / vmax)
    return 1.0 + normalized * 22.0

    """Draw a cubic bezier curve between two points."""
    # Control points for smooth S-curve
    cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y0)
    cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y1)

    verts = [
        (x0, y0),
        cp1,
        cp2,
        (x1, y1),
    ]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)

    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                                linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder,
                                capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Sort edges: draw smaller ones first (they'll be behind)

for e in edges_sorted:

    tgt_id = e["target"]
    src_node = id_to_node[src_id]
    tgt_node = id_to_node[tgt_id]

    x0 = layer_x[src_node["layer"]] + 0.04

    x1 = layer_x[tgt_node["layer"]] - 0.01
    y1 = y_positions[tgt_id]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] is not None else 0.5
    lw = vol_to_lw(vol)

    mode = e["mode"]
    edge_color = edge_mode_colors.get(mode, "#999")
    zorder = edge_mode_zorder.get(mode, 1)

    draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, edge_color, alpha=0.50, zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES (rounded rectangles)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

node_w = 0.035
node_h = 0.026

for n in nodes_data:
    x_center = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_center = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_center - node_w/2
    y0 = y_center - node_h/2

    color = get_node_color(n)

    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
        facecolor=color,
        edgecolor="white",
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=10,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    label_text = n["label"]
    # Truncate long labels
    if len(label_text) > 15:
        label_text = label_text[:14] + "…"

    # Volume annotation
    vol_text = ""
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        vol_text = f"\n{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB"

    ax.text(x_center, y_center, label_text + vol_text,
            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=5.5, fontweight="bold",
            color="white", zorder=11,
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.0, foreground="#333")])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
layer_labels = [
    ("DATA SOURCES", 0.05, "#3A7CA5"),
    ("INGESTION", 0.22, "#708090"),
    ("BRONZE (Raw)", 0.39, "#CD7F32"),
    ("SILVER (Curated)", 0.56, "#A8B8C8"),
    ("GOLD (Business)", 0.73, "#DAA520"),
    ("CONSUMPTION", 0.90, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, color in layer_labels:
    ax.text(xpos, 0.985, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold", color=color, family="monospace")
    # Underline bar
    ax.plot([xpos - 0.03, xpos + 0.03], [0.978, 0.978],
            color=color, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle="round", transform=ax.transData)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE OVERLAY (colored bars with annotations)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Governance bars above layers
gov_layer_info = {}
for g in governance:
    ly = g["layer"]
    if ly not in gov_layer_info:
        gov_layer_info[ly] = []
    gov_layer_info[ly].append(g)

# Draw governance indicator bars at top of each layer
for ly, xpos in [("ingestion", 0.22), ("bronze", 0.39), ("silver", 0.56),
                  ("gold", 0.73), ("consumption", 0.90)]:
    if ly in gov_layer_info:
        # Count enforcement types
        enf_counts = {}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture: Sankey-style flow diagram with governance & transformation overlays."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

# ── Color palettes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
category_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#2B6B8F",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#3A7CA5",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#1E5A78",
    "External/3rd Party": "#5B9BB5",
    "Databases":          "#4682A0",
}

layer_colors = {
    "source":       "#3A7CA5",
    "ingestion":    "#708090",
    "bronze":       "#CD7F32",
    "silver":       "#A8B8C8",
    "gold":         "#DAA520",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}

consumption_colors = {
    "BI":          "#2E7D32",
    "ML":          "#7B4173",
    "API":         "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL": "#DAA520",
}

gov_enforcement_colors = {
    "automated":    "#2E7D32",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#C0392B",
    "scheduled":    "#2980B9",
}

edge_mode_colors = {
    "streaming": "#2E7D32",
    "batch":     "#E67E22",
    "cdc":       "#8E44AD",
    "query":     "#999999",
}

edge_mode_zorder = {
    "streaming": 4,
    "cdc": 3,
    "batch": 2,
    "query": 1,
}

# ── Node index mapping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
node_ids = [n["node_id"] for n in nodes_data]
id_to_idx = {nid: i for i, nid in enumerate(node_ids)}
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Layer x-positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
layer_x = {
    "source":       0.05,
    "ingestion":    0.22,
    "bronze":       0.39,
    "silver":       0.56,
    "gold":         0.73,
    "consumption":  0.90,
}

# ── Node y-positions (manual arrangement to minimize crossings) ────────────
# Arrange nodes within each layer, top to bottom
layer_nodes = {ly: [] for ly in layer_x}
for n in nodes_data:
    layer_nodes[n["layer"]].append(n)

# Sort within each layer for visual clarity
source_order = [
    "src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream", "src_nosql",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_crm", "src_social", "src_files", "src_market"
]
ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

# Compute y-positions
y_positions = {}
total_height = 1.0
y_top = 0.93
y_bottom = 0.07
available_height = y_top - y_bottom

for ly in ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n_nodes = len(order)
    if n_nodes == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = available_height / (n_nodes - 1)
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_top - i * spacing

# ── Helper: hex to rgba ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hex_to_rgba(hex_color, alpha):
    h = hex_color.lstrip("#")
    r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
    return (r/255, g/255, b/255, alpha)

# ── Node color lookup ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return category_colors.get(n["category"], "#6B8E9B")
    elif n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return consumption_colors.get(n["category"], layer_colors[n["layer"]])
    else:
        return layer_colors.get(n["layer"], "#999999")

# ── Figure setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(26, 16), facecolor="#FAFBFC")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.02, 0.06, 0.96, 0.85])  # Leave room for titles and legends
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.02)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.02)
ax.axis("off")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (thick curved lines, volume-weighted)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Collect volumes for scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vmin, vmax = min(all_vols), max(all_vols)

def vol_to_lw(vol):
    """Map volume to linewidth using sqrt scale."""
    if vol is None or vol <= 0:
        return 1.2
    # sqrt scale for better differentiation of medium volumes
    normalized = np.sqrt(vol / vmax)
    return 1.0 + normalized * 22.0

def draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, color, alpha=0.55, zorder=2):
    """Draw a cubic bezier curve between two points."""
    # Control points for smooth S-curve
    cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y0)
    cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.4, y1)

    verts = [
        (x0, y0),
        cp1,
        cp2,
        (x1, y1),
    ]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)

    patch = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                                linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=zorder,
                                capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Sort edges: draw smaller ones first (they'll be behind)
edges_sorted = sorted(edges_data, key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

for e in edges_sorted:
    src_id = e["source"]
    tgt_id = e["target"]
    src_node = id_to_node[src_id]
    tgt_node = id_to_node[tgt_id]

    x0 = layer_x[src_node["layer"]] + 0.04
    y0 = y_positions[src_id]
    x1 = layer_x[tgt_node["layer"]] - 0.01
    y1 = y_positions[tgt_id]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] is not None else 0.5
    lw = vol_to_lw(vol)

    mode = e["mode"]
    edge_color = edge_mode_colors.get(mode, "#999")
    zorder = edge_mode_zorder.get(mode, 1)

    draw_bezier_edge(ax, x0, y0, x1, y1, lw, edge_color, alpha=0.50, zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES (rounded rectangles)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

node_w = 0.035
node_h = 0.026

for n in nodes_data:

    color = get_node_color(n)

    rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.003",
        facecolor=color,
        edgecolor="white",
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=10,
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    # Node label
    label_text = n["label"]
    # Truncate long labels
    if len(label_text) > 15:
        label_text = label_text[:14] + "…"

    # Volume annotation
    vol_text = ""
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        vol_text = f"\n{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB"

    ax.text(x_center, y_center, label_text + vol_text,
            ha="center", va="center", fontsize=5.5, fontweight="bold",
            color="white", zorder=11,
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.0, foreground="#333")])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
layer_labels = [
    ("DATA SOURCES", 0.05, "#3A7CA5"),
    ("INGESTION", 0.22, "#708090"),
    ("BRONZE (Raw)", 0.39, "#CD7F32"),
    ("SILVER (Curated)", 0.56, "#A8B8C8"),
    ("GOLD (Business)", 0.73, "#DAA520"),
    ("CONSUMPTION", 0.90, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, color in layer_labels:
    ax.text(xpos, 0.985, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9.5,
            fontweight="bold", color=color, family="monospace")
    # Underline bar
    ax.plot([xpos - 0.03, xpos + 0.03], [0.978, 0.978],
            color=color, linewidth=3, solid_capstyle="round", transform=ax.transData)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE OVERLAY (colored bars with annotations)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Governance bars above layers

for g in governance:
    ly = g["layer"]
    if ly not in gov_layer_info:
        gov_layer_info[ly] = []
    gov_layer_info[ly].append(g)

# Draw governance indicator bars at top of each layer

    text = f"{ly_name}: " + " | ".join(control_names)

gov_full_text = "GOVERNANCE CONTROLS — " + "  ◆  ".join(gov_text_lines)
ax.text(0.50, gov_summary_y, gov_full_text, ha="center", va="top",
        fontsize=5.5, color="#555", family="monospace",
        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor="#F0F0F0",
                  edgecolor="#DDD", alpha=0.9))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSFORMATION BADGES (on medallion layers)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

for t in transforms:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Shows complete data pipeline from 10 sources through medallion layers to 6 consumption
endpoints, with governance overlay, transformation staging, and volume-weighted flows.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA LOADING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR SYSTEM
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#1A6B8A",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#0F4C6B",
    "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases":          "#226688",
}
layer_fills = {
    "ingestion":    "#6C7A89",
    "bronze":       "#C07830",
    "silver":       "#8E9DAE",
    "gold":         "#C89830",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}
con_colors = {
    "BI":           "#2E7D32",
    "ML":           "#7B4173",
    "API":          "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL":  "#C89830",
}
edge_colors = {
    "streaming":    "#2ECC71",
    "batch":        "#E67E22",
    "cdc":          "#9B59B6",
    "query":        "#AAAAAA",

    f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in cross_controls)
ax_main.text(0.50, 0.017, cross_text, fontsize=5.0, ha="center", va="center",
            color="#555", fontstyle="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (Bezier curves, volume-weighted, layered by mode)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Sort: draw query first (back), then batch, then cdc, then streaming (front)
mode_z = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}

for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode]
    # Within each mode, draw smallest volumes first
    mode_edges.sort(key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

    for e in mode_edges:
        src = id_to_node[e["source"]]
        tgt = id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0 = layer_x[src["layer"]] + 0.042
        y0 = y_positions[e["source"]]
        x1 = layer_x[tgt["layer"]] - 0.042
        y1 = y_positions[e["target"]]

        lw = vol_lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = edge_colors.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        alpha = 0.38 if mode == "query" else 0.52

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y0)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y1)
        verts = [(x0, y0), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        path = Path(verts, codes)

        p = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=ec,
                               linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=8 + mode_z[mode],
                               capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax_main.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
node_w = 0.046
node_h = 0.030

for n in nodes_data:
    x_c = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_c = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_c - node_w/2
    y0 = y_c - node_h/2
    col = node_color(n)

    # Shadow
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0 + 0.002, y0 - 0.002), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000022",
        edgecolor="none", zorder=17))
    # Main rect
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.5, zorder=18))

    # Label (compact)
    label = n["label"]
    # Shorter abbreviations for very long labels
    abbrevs = {
        "Application Logs": "App Logs",
        "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
        "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs",
        "Market Data Feeds": "Market Feeds",
        "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB",
        "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
        "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares",
        "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
        "ERP System": "ERP",
        "CRM Platform": "CRM",
    }
    label = abbrevs.get(label, label)
    if len(label) > 13:
        label = label[:12] + "…"

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_c + 0.002, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.2, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=19,
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.3, foreground="#33333366")])

    # Volume below (non-consumption only)
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax_main.text(x_c, y_c - node_h/2 - 0.008, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",

# Source category labels
src_cat_y = {cat: max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)

for t in transforms:
    trans_by_layer.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0, "types": []})
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["types"].append(t["transformation_type"])

for ly in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    info = trans_by_layer.get(ly, {})
    if not info:
        continue
    x_c = layer_x[ly]

    summary_text = (f"⚙ {info['total']} total transformations\n"
                    f"  Low: {info.get('L',0)}  Med: {info.get('M',0)}  High: {info.get('H',0)}")

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_pos, summary_text, ha="center", va="bottom",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Shows complete data pipeline from 10 sources through medallion layers to 6 consumption
endpoints, with governance overlay, transformation staging, and volume-weighted flows.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA LOADING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR SYSTEM
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#1A6B8A",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#0F4C6B",
    "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases":          "#226688",
}
layer_fills = {
    "ingestion":    "#6C7A89",
    "bronze":       "#C07830",
    "silver":       "#8E9DAE",
    "gold":         "#C89830",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}
con_colors = {
    "BI":           "#2E7D32",
    "ML":           "#7B4173",
    "API":          "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL":  "#C89830",
}
edge_colors = {
    "streaming":    "#2ECC71",
    "batch":        "#E67E22",
    "cdc":          "#9B59B6",
    "query":        "#AAAAAA",
}

gov_colors = {
    "automated":    "#27AE60",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#E74C3C",
    "scheduled":    "#3498DB",
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(28, 17), facecolor="#F7F8FA")
ax_main = fig.add_axes([0.03, 0.10, 0.94, 0.80])
ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1.0)
ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
ax_main.axis("off")

# Layer x-centers (spaced evenly)
layers = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
layer_x = {ly: 0.04 + i * 0.184 for i, ly in enumerate(layers)}

# Source-category groupings
source_categories = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      ["src_iot"],
    "Enterprise Apps":    ["src_erp", "src_crm", "src_files"],
    "Logs/Clickstream":   ["src_logs", "src_clickstream"],
    "External/3rd Party": ["src_social", "src_market"],
    "Databases":          ["src_rdbms", "src_nosql"],
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODE POSITIONING (compute y for each node)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Build ordered node lists per layer, keeping source categories together
source_order = []
for cat_name in ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
                  "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]:
    source_order.extend(source_categories.get(cat_name, []))

ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]

bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

y_positions = {}
for ly in layers:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n = len(order)
    if n == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = 0.85 / (n - 1)
        y_start = 0.92
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_start - i * spacing

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return cat_colors.get(n["category"], "#888")
    if n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return con_colors.get(n["category"], layer_fills[n["layer"]])
    return layer_fills.get(n["layer"], "#999")

def hex_rgba(h, a):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return (int(h[0:2],16)/255, int(h[2:4],16)/255, int(h[4:6],16)/255, a)

# Volume → linewidth scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vol_max = max(all_vols)

def vol_lw(v):
    if v is None:
        return 0.6
    return 0.6 + np.sqrt(v / vol_max) * 18.0

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE BACKGROUND BANDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

gov_by_layer = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by_layer.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    x_c = layer_x[ly]
    bw = 0.074
    ax_main.add_patch(
        mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x_c - bw, 0.948), bw * 2, 0.052,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#E8ECF0",
            edgecolor="#DDD", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0, alpha=0.7))

    if ly in gov_by_layer:
        items = gov_by_layer[ly]
        n_items = len(items)
        seg_w = bw * 1.8 / n_items
        for i, g in enumerate(items):
            sx = x_c - bw * 0.9 + i * seg_w
            ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
                (sx, 0.951), seg_w - 0.003, 0.014,
                boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=gov_colors.get(g["enforcement"], "#999"),
                edgecolor="none", alpha=0.75, zorder=1))
            ax_main.text(sx + seg_w/2, 0.970, g["control_type"],
                        fontsize=3.0, ha="center", va="center", color="#444",
                        rotation=90, zorder=2)

    ax_main.text(x_c, 0.945, "GOVERNANCE", fontsize=4.5, ha="center", va="bottom",
                color="#999", fontweight="bold", style="italic")

# Cross-layer governance strip
ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.12, 0.008), 0.76, 0.018,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.003", facecolor="#F0F4F8",
    edgecolor="#DDD", linewidth=0.6, zorder=0))
cross_controls = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
cross_text = "CROSS-LAYER: " + "  |  ".join(
    f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in cross_controls)
ax_main.text(0.50, 0.017, cross_text, fontsize=5.0, ha="center", va="center",
            color="#555", fontstyle="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (Bezier curves, volume-weighted, layered by mode)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Sort: draw query first (back), then batch, then cdc, then streaming (front)
mode_z = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}

for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode]
    # Within each mode, draw smallest volumes first
    mode_edges.sort(key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

    for e in mode_edges:
        src = id_to_node[e["source"]]
        tgt = id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0 = layer_x[src["layer"]] + 0.042
        y0 = y_positions[e["source"]]
        x1 = layer_x[tgt["layer"]] - 0.042
        y1 = y_positions[e["target"]]

        lw = vol_lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = edge_colors.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        alpha = 0.38 if mode == "query" else 0.52

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y0)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y1)
        verts = [(x0, y0), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        path = Path(verts, codes)

        p = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=ec,
                               linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=8 + mode_z[mode],
                               capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax_main.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
node_w = 0.046
node_h = 0.030

for n in nodes_data:
    x_c = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_c = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_c - node_w/2
    y0 = y_c - node_h/2
    col = node_color(n)

    # Shadow
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0 + 0.002, y0 - 0.002), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000022",
        edgecolor="none", zorder=17))
    # Main rect
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.5, zorder=18))

    # Label (compact)
    label = n["label"]
    # Shorter abbreviations for very long labels
    abbrevs = {
        "Application Logs": "App Logs",
        "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
        "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs",
        "Market Data Feeds": "Market Feeds",
        "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB",
        "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
        "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares",
        "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
        "ERP System": "ERP",
        "CRM Platform": "CRM",
    }
    label = abbrevs.get(label, label)
    if len(label) > 13:
        label = label[:12] + "…"

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_c + 0.002, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.2, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=19,
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.3, foreground="#33333366")])

    # Volume below (non-consumption only)
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax_main.text(x_c, y_c - node_h/2 - 0.008, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",
                    ha="center", va="top", fontsize=4.8, color="#666", zorder=19)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
header_info = [
    ("DATA SOURCES\n5 Categories", 0.04 + 0*0.184, "#1A6B8A"),
    ("INGESTION\n3 Engines",        0.04 + 1*0.184, "#6C7A89"),
    ("BRONZE LAYER\nRaw / Landing", 0.04 + 2*0.184, "#C07830"),
    ("SILVER LAYER\nCurated / Clean", 0.04 + 3*0.184, "#8E9DAE"),
    ("GOLD LAYER\nBusiness / Aggregated", 0.04 + 4*0.184, "#C89830"),
    ("CONSUMPTION\n6 Endpoints",    0.04 + 5*0.184, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, col in header_info:
    ax_main.text(xpos, 1.005, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.0,
                fontweight="bold", color=col, family="monospace", linespacing=1.2)
    ax_main.plot([xpos-0.032, xpos+0.032], [0.998, 0.998],
                color=col, linewidth=3.5, solid_capstyle="round")

# Source category labels
src_cat_y = {cat: max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
             + (min(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids) - max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids))/2
             for cat, nids in source_categories.items()}

for cat in ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
            "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]:
    nids = source_categories[cat]
    top = max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
    bot = min(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
    ax_main.plot([0.012, 0.012], [bot + 0.005, top - 0.005],
                color=cat_colors[cat], linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=5)
    ax_main.text(0.010, (top + bot)/2, cat, fontsize=5.2, ha="right",
                va="center", color=cat_colors[cat], fontweight="bold", zorder=20)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSFORMATION CALLOUTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transforms:
    trans_by_layer.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0, "types": []})
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["types"].append(t["transformation_type"])

for ly in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    info = trans_by_layer.get(ly, {})
    if not info:
        continue
    x_c = layer_x[ly]
    y_pos = 0.04

    summary_text = (f"⚙ {info['total']} total transformations\n"
                    f"  Low: {info.get('L',0)}  Med: {info.get('M',0)}  High: {info.get('H',0)}")

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_pos, summary_text, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.8, color="#444", family="monospace",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", facecolor="white",
                         edgecolor="#BBB", linewidth=0.8), zorder=21)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VOLUME FLOW LEGEND (scale reference)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
legend_x = 0.935
ax_main.text(legend_x + 0.015, 0.92, "EDGE\nVOLUME", fontsize=5.5, ha="center",
            va="bottom", color="#999", fontweight="bold")

for i, (vol, label) in enumerate([(530, "530"), (200, "200"), (50, "50"), (5, "5")]):
    ly = 0.82 - i * 0.065
    lw = vol_lw(vol)
    ax_main.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.03], [ly, ly], color="#888",
                linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax_main.text(legend_x + 0.033, ly, f"{label} GB", fontsize=4.5,
                color="#888", va="center")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BOTTOM LEGENDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
leg_y = 0.07
leg_items = [
    ("Source Categories:", cat_colors),
    ("Medallion:", {"Bronze": "#C07830", "Silver": "#8E9DAE", "Gold": "#C89830"}),
    ("Consumption:", con_colors),
    ("Flow Mode:", edge_colors),
    ("Governance:", gov_colors),
]

seg_x = 0.04
for title, cmap in leg_items:
    ax_main.text(seg_x, leg_y, title, fontsize=5.0, ha="left", va="center",
                color="#555", fontweight="bold")
    seg_x += 0.112
    for name, col in cmap.items():
        ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (seg_x, leg_y - 0.004), 0.010, 0.008,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.001", facecolor=col, edgecolor="none", zorder=20))
        ax_main.text(seg_x + 0.012, leg_y, name, fontsize=4.5, ha="left",
                    va="center", color="#666")
        seg_x += 0.054
    seg_x += 0.022

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Data Pipeline & Governance",
             fontsize=19, fontweight="bold", color="#1a1a1a", y=0.993)
fig.text(0.5, 0.975,
         "10 Data Sources → 3 Ingestion Modes → 5 Bronze / 5 Silver / 5 Gold Datasets → 6 Consumption Endpoints  |  "
         "Volume-Weighted Flow Paths  |  15 Cross-Cutting Governance Controls",
         ha="center", fontsize=8.2, color="#777", style="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXPORT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, facecolor="#F7F8FA",
            edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
