#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Shows complete data pipeline from 10 sources through medallion layers to 6 consumption
endpoints, with governance overlay, transformation staging, and volume-weighted flows.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA LOADING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR SYSTEM
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#1A6B8A",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#0F4C6B",
    "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases":          "#226688",
}
layer_fills = {
    "ingestion":    "#6C7A89",
    "bronze":       "#C07830",
    "silver":       "#8E9DAE",
    "gold":         "#C89830",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}
con_colors = {
    "BI":           "#2E7D32",
    "ML":           "#7B4173",
    "API":          "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL":  "#C89830",
}
edge_colors = {
    "streaming":    "#2ECC71",
    "batch":        "#E67E22",
    "cdc":          "#9B59B6",
    "query":        "#AAAAAA",
}

gov_colors = {
    "automated":    "#27AE60",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#E74C3C",
    "scheduled":    "#3498DB",
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(28, 17), facecolor="#F7F8FA")
ax_main = fig.add_axes([0.03, 0.10, 0.94, 0.80])
ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1.0)
ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
ax_main.axis("off")

# Layer x-centers (spaced evenly)
layers = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
layer_x = {ly: 0.04 + i * 0.184 for i, ly in enumerate(layers)}

# Source-category groupings
source_categories = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      ["src_iot"],
    "Enterprise Apps":    ["src_erp", "src_crm", "src_files"],
    "Logs/Clickstream":   ["src_logs", "src_clickstream"],
    "External/3rd Party": ["src_social", "src_market"],
    "Databases":          ["src_rdbms", "src_nosql"],
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODE POSITIONING (compute y for each node)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Build ordered node lists per layer, keeping source categories together
source_order = []
for cat_name in ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
                  "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]:
    source_order.extend(source_categories.get(cat_name, []))

ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]

bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

y_positions = {}
for ly in layers:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n = len(order)
    if n == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = 0.85 / (n - 1)
        y_start = 0.92
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_start - i * spacing

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return cat_colors.get(n["category"], "#888")
    if n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return con_colors.get(n["category"], layer_fills[n["layer"]])
    return layer_fills.get(n["layer"], "#999")

def hex_rgba(h, a):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return (int(h[0:2],16)/255, int(h[2:4],16)/255, int(h[4:6],16)/255, a)

# Volume → linewidth scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vol_max = max(all_vols)

def vol_lw(v):
    if v is None:
        return 0.6
    return 0.6 + np.sqrt(v / vol_max) * 18.0

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE BACKGROUND BANDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

gov_by_layer = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by_layer.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    x_c = layer_x[ly]
    bw = 0.074
    ax_main.add_patch(
        mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x_c - bw, 0.948), bw * 2, 0.052,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#E8ECF0",
            edgecolor="#DDD", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0, alpha=0.7))

    if ly in gov_by_layer:
        items = gov_by_layer[ly]
        n_items = len(items)
        seg_w = bw * 1.8 / n_items
        for i, g in enumerate(items):
            sx = x_c - bw * 0.9 + i * seg_w
            ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
                (sx, 0.951), seg_w - 0.003, 0.014,
                boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=gov_colors.get(g["enforcement"], "#999"),
                edgecolor="none", alpha=0.75, zorder=1))
            ax_main.text(sx + seg_w/2, 0.970, g["control_type"],
                        fontsize=3.0, ha="center", va="center", color="#444",
                        rotation=90, zorder=2)

    ax_main.text(x_c, 0.945, "GOVERNANCE", fontsize=4.5, ha="center", va="bottom",
                color="#999", fontweight="bold", style="italic")

# Cross-layer governance strip
ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.12, 0.008), 0.76, 0.018,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.003", facecolor="#F0F4F8",
    edgecolor="#DDD", linewidth=0.6, zorder=0))
cross_controls = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
cross_text = "CROSS-LAYER: " + "  |  ".join(
    f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in cross_controls)
ax_main.text(0.50, 0.017, cross_text, fontsize=5.0, ha="center", va="center",
            color="#555", fontstyle="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (Bezier curves, volume-weighted, layered by mode)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Sort: draw query first (back), then batch, then cdc, then streaming (front)
mode_z = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}

for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode]
    # Within each mode, draw smallest volumes first
    mode_edges.sort(key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

    for e in mode_edges:
        src = id_to_node[e["source"]]
        tgt = id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0 = layer_x[src["layer"]] + 0.042
        y0 = y_positions[e["source"]]
        x1 = layer_x[tgt["layer"]] - 0.042
        y1 = y_positions[e["target"]]

        lw = vol_lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = edge_colors.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        alpha = 0.38 if mode == "query" else 0.52

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y0)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y1)
        verts = [(x0, y0), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        path = Path(verts, codes)

        p = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=ec,
                               linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=8 + mode_z[mode],
                               capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax_main.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
node_w = 0.046
node_h = 0.030

for n in nodes_data:
    x_c = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_c = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_c - node_w/2
    y0 = y_c - node_h/2
    col = node_color(n)

    # Shadow
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0 + 0.002, y0 - 0.002), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000022",
        edgecolor="none", zorder=17))
    # Main rect
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.5, zorder=18))

    # Label (compact)
    label = n["label"]
    # Shorter abbreviations for very long labels
    abbrevs = {
        "Application Logs": "App Logs",
        "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
        "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs",
        "Market Data Feeds": "Market Feeds",
        "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB",
        "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
        "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares",
        "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
        "ERP System": "ERP",
        "CRM Platform": "CRM",
    }
    label = abbrevs.get(label, label)
    if len(label) > 13:
        label = label[:12] + "…"

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_c + 0.002, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.2, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=19,
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.3, foreground="#33333366")])

    # Volume below (non-consumption only)
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax_main.text(x_c, y_c - node_h/2 - 0.008, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",
                    ha="center", va="top", fontsize=4.8, color="#666", zorder=19)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
header_info = [
    ("DATA SOURCES\n5 Categories", 0.04 + 0*0.184, "#1A6B8A"),
    ("INGESTION\n3 Engines",        0.04 + 1*0.184, "#6C7A89"),
    ("BRONZE LAYER\nRaw / Landing", 0.04 + 2*0.184, "#C07830"),
    ("SILVER LAYER\nCurated / Clean", 0.04 + 3*0.184, "#8E9DAE"),
    ("GOLD LAYER\nBusiness / Aggregated", 0.04 + 4*0.184, "#C89830"),
    ("CONSUMPTION\n6 Endpoints",    0.04 + 5*0.184, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, col in header_info:
    ax_main.text(xpos, 1.005, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.0,
                fontweight="bold", color=col, family="monospace", linespacing=1.2)
    ax_main.plot([xpos-0.032, xpos+0.032], [0.998, 0.998],
                color=col, linewidth=3.5, solid_capstyle="round")

# Source category labels
src_cat_y = {cat: max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
             + (min(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids) - max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids))/2
             for cat, nids in source_categories.items()}

for cat in ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
            "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]:
    nids = source_categories[cat]
    top = max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
    bot = min(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
    ax_main.plot([0.012, 0.012], [bot + 0.005, top - 0.005],
                color=cat_colors[cat], linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=5)
    ax_main.text(0.010, (top + bot)/2, cat, fontsize=5.2, ha="right",
                va="center", color=cat_colors[cat], fontweight="bold", zorder=20)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSFORMATION CALLOUTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transforms:
    trans_by_layer.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0, "types": []})
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["types"].append(t["transformation_type"])

for ly in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    info = trans_by_layer.get(ly, {})
    if not info:
        continue
    x_c = layer_x[ly]
    y_pos = 0.04

    summary_text = (f"⚙ {info['total']} total transformations\n"
                    f"  Low: {info.get('L',0)}  Med: {info.get('M',0)}  High: {info.get('H',0)}")

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_pos, summary_text, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.8, color="#444", family="monospace",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", facecolor="white",
                         edgecolor="#BBB", linewidth=0.8), zorder=21)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VOLUME FLOW LEGEND (scale reference)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
legend_x = 0.935
ax_main.text(legend_x + 0.015, 0.92, "EDGE\nVOLUME", fontsize=5.5, ha="center",
            va="bottom", color="#999", fontweight="bold")

for i, (vol, label) in enumerate([(530, "530"), (200, "200"), (50, "50"), (5, "5")]):
    ly = 0.82 - i * 0.065
    lw = vol_lw(vol)
    ax_main.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.03], [ly, ly], color="#888",
                linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax_main.text(legend_x + 0.033, ly, f"{label} GB", fontsize=4.5,
                color="#888", va="center")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BOTTOM LEGENDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
leg_y = 0.07
leg_items = [
    ("Source Categories:", cat_colors),
    ("Medallion:", {"Bronze": "#C07830", "Silver": "#8E9DAE", "Gold": "#C89830"}),
    ("Consumption:", con_colors),
    ("Flow Mode:", edge_colors),
    ("Governance:", gov_colors),
]

seg_x = 0.04
for title, cmap in leg_items:
    ax_main.text(seg_x, leg_y, title, fontsize=5.0, ha="left", va="center",
                color="#555", fontweight="bold")
    seg_x += 0.112
    for name, col in cmap.items():
        ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (seg_x, leg_y - 0.004), 0.010, 0.008,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.001", facecolor=col, edgecolor="none", zorder=20))
        ax_main.text(seg_x + 0.012, leg_y, name, fontsize=4.5, ha="left",
                    va="center", color="#666")
        seg_x += 0.054
    seg_x += 0.022

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Data Pipeline & Governance",
             fontsize=19, fontweight="bold", color="#1a1a1a", y=0.993)
fig.text(0.5, 0.975,
         "10 Data Sources → 3 Ingestion Modes → 5 Bronze / 5 Silver / 5 Gold Datasets → 6 Consumption Endpoints  |  "
         "Volume-Weighted Flow Paths  |  15 Cross-Cutting Governance Controls",
         ha="center", fontsize=8.2, color="#777", style="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXPORT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, facecolor="#F7F8FA",
            edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Shows complete data pipeline from 10 sources through medallion layers to 6 consumption
endpoints, with governance overlay, transformation staging, and volume-weighted flows.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA LOADING
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLOR SYSTEM
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat_colors = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      "#1A6B8A",
    "Enterprise Apps":    "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream":   "#0F4C6B",
    "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases":          "#226688",
}
layer_fills = {
    "ingestion":    "#6C7A89",
    "bronze":       "#C07830",
    "silver":       "#8E9DAE",
    "gold":         "#C89830",
    "consumption":  "#2E7D56",
}
con_colors = {
    "BI":           "#2E7D32",
    "ML":           "#7B4173",
    "API":          "#2B6B8F",
    "Reverse ETL":  "#C89830",
}
edge_colors = {
    "streaming":    "#2ECC71",
    "batch":        "#E67E22",
    "cdc":          "#9B59B6",
    "query":        "#AAAAAA",
}

gov_colors = {
    "automated":    "#27AE60",
    "policy-based": "#E67E22",
    "manual":       "#E74C3C",
    "scheduled":    "#3498DB",
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(28, 17), facecolor="#F7F8FA")
ax_main = fig.add_axes([0.03, 0.10, 0.94, 0.80])
ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1.0)
ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1.0)
ax_main.axis("off")

# Layer x-centers (spaced evenly)
layers = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
layer_x = {ly: 0.04 + i * 0.184 for i, ly in enumerate(layers)}

# Source-category groupings
source_categories = {
    "IoT/Streaming":      ["src_iot"],
    "Enterprise Apps":    ["src_erp", "src_crm", "src_files"],
    "Logs/Clickstream":   ["src_logs", "src_clickstream"],
    "External/3rd Party": ["src_social", "src_market"],
    "Databases":          ["src_rdbms", "src_nosql"],
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODE POSITIONING (compute y for each node)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Build ordered node lists per layer, keeping source categories together
source_order = []
for cat_name in ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
                  "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]:
    source_order.extend(source_categories.get(cat_name, []))

ingestion_order = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]

bronze_order = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
silver_order = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
gold_order = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
              "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
consumption_order = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                     "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

layer_orders = {
    "source": source_order,
    "ingestion": ingestion_order,
    "bronze": bronze_order,
    "silver": silver_order,
    "gold": gold_order,
    "consumption": consumption_order,
}

y_positions = {}
for ly in layers:
    order = layer_orders[ly]
    n = len(order)
    if n == 1:
        y_positions[order[0]] = 0.5
    else:
        spacing = 0.85 / (n - 1)
        y_start = 0.92
        for i, nid in enumerate(order):
            y_positions[nid] = y_start - i * spacing

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def node_color(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source":
        return cat_colors.get(n["category"], "#888")
    if n["layer"] == "consumption":
        return con_colors.get(n["category"], layer_fills[n["layer"]])
    return layer_fills.get(n["layer"], "#999")

def hex_rgba(h, a):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return (int(h[0:2],16)/255, int(h[2:4],16)/255, int(h[4:6],16)/255, a)

# Volume → linewidth scaling
all_vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
vol_max = max(all_vols)

def vol_lw(v):
    if v is None:
        return 0.6
    return 0.6 + np.sqrt(v / vol_max) * 18.0

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE BACKGROUND BANDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

gov_by_layer = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by_layer.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    x_c = layer_x[ly]
    bw = 0.074
    ax_main.add_patch(
        mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((x_c - bw, 0.948), bw * 2, 0.052,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#E8ECF0",
            edgecolor="#DDD", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0, alpha=0.7))

    if ly in gov_by_layer:
        items = gov_by_layer[ly]
        n_items = len(items)
        seg_w = bw * 1.8 / n_items
        for i, g in enumerate(items):
            sx = x_c - bw * 0.9 + i * seg_w
            ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
                (sx, 0.951), seg_w - 0.003, 0.014,
                boxstyle="round,pad=0.002",
                facecolor=gov_colors.get(g["enforcement"], "#999"),
                edgecolor="none", alpha=0.75, zorder=1))
            ax_main.text(sx + seg_w/2, 0.970, g["control_type"],
                        fontsize=3.0, ha="center", va="center", color="#444",
                        rotation=90, zorder=2)

    ax_main.text(x_c, 0.945, "GOVERNANCE", fontsize=4.5, ha="center", va="bottom",
                color="#999", fontweight="bold", style="italic")

# Cross-layer governance strip
ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.12, 0.008), 0.76, 0.018,
    boxstyle="round,pad=0.003", facecolor="#F0F4F8",
    edgecolor="#DDD", linewidth=0.6, zorder=0))
cross_controls = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
cross_text = "CROSS-LAYER: " + "  |  ".join(
    f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in cross_controls)
ax_main.text(0.50, 0.017, cross_text, fontsize=5.0, ha="center", va="center",
            color="#555", fontstyle="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW EDGES (Bezier curves, volume-weighted, layered by mode)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Sort: draw query first (back), then batch, then cdc, then streaming (front)
mode_z = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}

for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode]
    # Within each mode, draw smallest volumes first
    mode_edges.sort(key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0)

    for e in mode_edges:
        src = id_to_node[e["source"]]
        tgt = id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0 = layer_x[src["layer"]] + 0.042
        y0 = y_positions[e["source"]]
        x1 = layer_x[tgt["layer"]] - 0.042
        y1 = y_positions[e["target"]]

        lw = vol_lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = edge_colors.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        alpha = 0.38 if mode == "query" else 0.52

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y0)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1 - x0) * 0.38, y1)
        verts = [(x0, y0), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        path = Path(verts, codes)

        p = mpatches.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=ec,
                               linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=8 + mode_z[mode],
                               capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax_main.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
node_w = 0.046
node_h = 0.030

for n in nodes_data:
    x_c = layer_x[n["layer"]]
    y_c = y_positions[n["node_id"]]
    x0 = x_c - node_w/2
    y0 = y_c - node_h/2
    col = node_color(n)

    # Shadow
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0 + 0.002, y0 - 0.002), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000022",
        edgecolor="none", zorder=17))
    # Main rect
    ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0, y0), node_w, node_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.5, zorder=18))

    # Label (compact)
    label = n["label"]
    # Shorter abbreviations for very long labels
    abbrevs = {
        "Application Logs": "App Logs",
        "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
        "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs",
        "Market Data Feeds": "Market Feeds",
        "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB",
        "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
        "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares",
        "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
        "ERP System": "ERP",
        "CRM Platform": "CRM",
    }
    label = abbrevs.get(label, label)
    if len(label) > 13:
        label = label[:12] + "…"

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_c + 0.002, label, ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=5.2, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=19,
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.3, foreground="#33333366")])

    # Volume below (non-consumption only)
    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax_main.text(x_c, y_c - node_h/2 - 0.008, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",
                    ha="center", va="top", fontsize=4.8, color="#666", zorder=19)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
header_info = [
    ("DATA SOURCES\n5 Categories", 0.04 + 0*0.184, "#1A6B8A"),
    ("INGESTION\n3 Engines",        0.04 + 1*0.184, "#6C7A89"),
    ("BRONZE LAYER\nRaw / Landing", 0.04 + 2*0.184, "#C07830"),
    ("SILVER LAYER\nCurated / Clean", 0.04 + 3*0.184, "#8E9DAE"),
    ("GOLD LAYER\nBusiness / Aggregated", 0.04 + 4*0.184, "#C89830"),
    ("CONSUMPTION\n6 Endpoints",    0.04 + 5*0.184, "#2E7D56"),
]

for label, xpos, col in header_info:
    ax_main.text(xpos, 1.005, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.0,
                fontweight="bold", color=col, family="monospace", linespacing=1.2)
    ax_main.plot([xpos-0.032, xpos+0.032], [0.998, 0.998],
                color=col, linewidth=3.5, solid_capstyle="round")

# Source category labels
src_cat_y = {cat: max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
             + (min(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids) - max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids))/2
             for cat, nids in source_categories.items()}

for cat in ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
            "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]:
    nids = source_categories[cat]
    top = max(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
    bot = min(y_positions[nid] for nid in nids)
    ax_main.plot([0.012, 0.012], [bot + 0.005, top - 0.005],
                color=cat_colors[cat], linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=5)
    ax_main.text(0.010, (top + bot)/2, cat, fontsize=5.2, ha="right",
                va="center", color=cat_colors[cat], fontweight="bold", zorder=20)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSFORMATION CALLOUTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

trans_by_layer = {}
for t in transforms:
    trans_by_layer.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0, "types": []})
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]
    trans_by_layer[t["layer"]]["types"].append(t["transformation_type"])

for ly in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    info = trans_by_layer.get(ly, {})
    if not info:
        continue
    x_c = layer_x[ly]
    y_pos = 0.04

    summary_text = (f"⚙ {info['total']} total transformations\n"
                    f"  Low: {info.get('L',0)}  Med: {info.get('M',0)}  High: {info.get('H',0)}")

    ax_main.text(x_c, y_pos, summary_text, ha="center", va="bottom",
                fontsize=4.8, color="#444", family="monospace",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.4", facecolor="white",
                         edgecolor="#BBB", linewidth=0.8), zorder=21)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VOLUME FLOW LEGEND (scale reference)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
legend_x = 0.935
ax_main.text(legend_x + 0.015, 0.92, "EDGE\nVOLUME", fontsize=5.5, ha="center",
            va="bottom", color="#999", fontweight="bold")

for i, (vol, label) in enumerate([(530, "530"), (200, "200"), (50, "50"), (5, "5")]):
    ly = 0.82 - i * 0.065
    lw = vol_lw(vol)
    ax_main.plot([legend_x, legend_x + 0.03], [ly, ly], color="#888",
                linewidth=lw, alpha=0.5, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax_main.text(legend_x + 0.033, ly, f"{label} GB", fontsize=4.5,
                color="#888", va="center")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BOTTOM LEGENDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
leg_y = 0.07
leg_items = [
    ("Source Categories:", cat_colors),
    ("Medallion:", {"Bronze": "#C07830", "Silver": "#8E9DAE", "Gold": "#C89830"}),
    ("Consumption:", con_colors),
    ("Flow Mode:", edge_colors),
    ("Governance:", gov_colors),
]

seg_x = 0.04
for title, cmap in leg_items:
    ax_main.text(seg_x, leg_y, title, fontsize=5.0, ha="left", va="center",
                color="#555", fontweight="bold")
    seg_x += 0.112
    for name, col in cmap.items():
        ax_main.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (seg_x, leg_y - 0.004), 0.010, 0.008,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.001", facecolor=col, edgecolor="none", zorder=20))
        ax_main.text(seg_x + 0.012, leg_y, name, fontsize=4.5, ha="left",
                    va="center", color="#666")
        seg_x += 0.054
    seg_x += 0.022

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Data Pipeline & Governance",
             fontsize=19, fontweight="bold", color="#1a1a1a", y=0.993)
fig.text(0.5, 0.975,
         "10 Data Sources → 3 Ingestion Modes → 5 Bronze / 5 Silver / 5 Gold Datasets → 6 Consumption Endpoints  |  "
         "Volume-Weighted Flow Paths  |  15 Cross-Cutting Governance Controls",
         ha="center", fontsize=8.2, color="#777", style="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXPORT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, facecolor="#F7F8FA",
            edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Complete data pipeline: 10 sources → ingestion → Bronze/Silver/Gold → 6 consumption endpoints.
Volume-weighted edges, governance overlay, transformation staging, consumption fanout.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json, os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Color system ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CAT = {
    "IoT/Streaming": "#156082", "Enterprise Apps": "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream": "#0D4A66", "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases": "#1E7099",
}
LAYER = {"ingestion": "#5A6B7D", "bronze": "#B8732E", "silver": "#8595A8",
         "gold": "#C4932E", "consumption": "#27754C"}
CON = {"BI": "#277540", "ML": "#773B70", "API": "#1E7099", "Reverse ETL": "#C4932E"}
EDGE = {"streaming": "#27AE60", "batch": "#E67E22", "cdc": "#9B59B6", "query": "#AAAAAA"}
GOV = {"automated": "#27AE60", "policy-based": "#E67E22", "manual": "#E74C3C", "scheduled": "#3498DB"}

# ── Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(30, 18), facecolor="#F5F6F8")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.025, 0.12, 0.95, 0.78])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.0); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.0); ax.axis("off")

layers = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
L_X = {ly: 0.035 + i * 0.186 for i, ly in enumerate(layers)}

# ── Node ordering & positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SOURCE_ORDER = ["src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_nosql", "src_crm", "src_files",
    "src_social", "src_market"]
INGEST_ORDER = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
BRONZE_ORDER = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
SILVER_ORDER = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
GOLD_ORDER   = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
                "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
CONS_ORDER   = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

ORDERS = {"source": SOURCE_ORDER, "ingestion": INGEST_ORDER,
    "bronze": BRONZE_ORDER, "silver": SILVER_ORDER,
    "gold": GOLD_ORDER, "consumption": CONS_ORDER}

y_pos = {}
for ly in layers:
    order = ORDERS[ly]; n = len(order)
    sp = 0.84 / (n - 1) if n > 1 else 0
    for i, nid in enumerate(order):
        y_pos[nid] = 0.92 - i * sp

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def nc(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source": return CAT.get(n["category"], "#888")
    if n["layer"] == "consumption": return CON.get(n["category"], LAYER[n["layer"]])
    return LAYER.get(n["layer"], "#999")

def hrgba(h, a):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return (int(h[0:2],16)/255, int(h[2:4],16)/255, int(h[4:6],16)/255, a)

vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
VMAX = max(vols)
def lw(v):
    if v is None: return 0.5
    return 0.5 + np.sqrt(v/VMAX) * 17.5

# ── Governance by layer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gov_by = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

# ── Transformation summary by layer ────────────────────────────────────────
txf = {}
for t in transforms:
    txf.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0})
    txf[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    txf[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE BACKGROUND PANEL (top of each layer column)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    xc = L_X[ly]; bw = 0.074
    # Background panel
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xc - bw, 0.958), bw * 2, 0.042,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.005", facecolor="#ECEEF1",
        edgecolor="#D5D8DC", linewidth=0.7, zorder=3))
    # Enforcement indicator dots
    if ly in gov_by:
        items = gov_by[ly]
        for i, g in enumerate(items):
            dot_x = xc - bw * 0.85 + i * (bw * 1.7 / max(len(items)-1, 1)) if len(items) > 1 else xc
            ax.scatter(dot_x, 0.978, s=38, color=GOV.get(g["enforcement"], "#999"),
                      edgecolors="white", linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
        # Count label
        n_auto = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "automated")
        n_pol  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "policy-based")
        n_man  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "manual")
        n_sch  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "scheduled")
        ax.text(xc, 0.962, f"⬤{n_auto} ⬤{n_pol} ⬤{n_man} ⬤{n_sch}",
               fontsize=4.2, ha="center", color="#888", zorder=5)

ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.15, 0.010), 0.70, 0.020, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
    facecolor="#ECEEF1", edgecolor="#D5D8DC", linewidth=0.6, zorder=3))

cross_ctrls = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
cross_txt = "  ◆  ".join(f"{g['control_type']} [{g['tool']}]" for g in cross_ctrls)
ax.text(0.50, 0.020, f"CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:  {cross_txt}",
       fontsize=5.8, ha="center", va="center", color="#555")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EDGES — Bezier curves layered by mode
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mode_priority = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}
for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = sorted(
        [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode],
        key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0
    )
    for e in mode_edges:
        s, t = id_to_node[e["source"]], id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0, y0_ = L_X[s["layer"]] + 0.042, y_pos[e["source"]]
        x1, y1_ = L_X[t["layer"]] - 0.042, y_pos[e["target"]]
        w = lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = EDGE.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        al = 0.42 if mode == "query" else 0.55

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1-x0)*0.38, y0_)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1-x0)*0.38, y1_)
        verts = [(x0, y0_), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1_)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        p = mpatches.PathPatch(Path(verts, codes), facecolor="none",
            edgecolor=ec, linewidth=w, alpha=al, zorder=10+mode_priority[mode],
            capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NW, NH = 0.047, 0.032

ABBREV = {
    "Application Logs": "App Logs", "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
    "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs", "Market Data Feeds": "Market Data",
    "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB", "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
    "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares", "ERP System": "ERP",
    "CRM Platform": "CRM", "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
    "Batch Ingestion": "Batch Ingest", "Stream Ingestion": "Stream Ingest",
    "Raw IoT Events": "Raw IoT", "Raw Transactions": "Raw Txn",
    "Raw Log Data": "Raw Logs", "Raw External Data": "Raw External",
    "Raw DB Snapshots": "Raw DB Snap", "Cleaned IoT Metrics": "Clean IoT",
    "Unified Customer 360": "Customer 360", "Sessionized Clickstream": "Sess. Clicks",
    "Enriched Transactions": "Enriched Txn", "Normalized Market Data": "Norm. Market",
    "Revenue Aggregates": "Revenue Agg", "Customer LTV Scores": "Customer LTV",
    "Anomaly Detection Features": "Anomaly Feat.", "Product Performance KPIs": "Product KPIs",
    "Marketing Attribution": "Marketing Attr", "Executive Dashboards": "Exec Dashboards",
    "Ad-hoc SQL Analytics": "Ad-hoc SQL", "ML Training Pipelines": "ML Training",
    "ML Serving Endpoints": "ML Serving", "Data API Services": "Data API",
    "Reverse ETL to SaaS": "Reverse ETL",
}

for n in nodes_data:
    xc, yc = L_X[n["layer"]], y_pos[n["node_id"]]
    x0r, y0r = xc - NW/2, yc - NH/2
    col = nc(n)

    # Shadow + main node
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0r+0.002, y0r-0.002), NW, NH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000018", edgecolor="none", zorder=19))
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0r, y0r), NW, NH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.8, zorder=20))

    label = ABBREV.get(n["label"], n["label"])
    if len(label) > 14:
        label = label[:13] + "…"

    ax.text(xc, yc+0.001, label, ha="center", va="center",
           fontsize=5.4, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=21,
           path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground="#00000044")])

    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax.text(xc, yc - NH/2 - 0.007, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",
               ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.0, color="#777", zorder=21)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Complete data pipeline: 10 sources → ingestion → Bronze/Silver/Gold → 6 consumption endpoints.
Volume-weighted edges, governance overlay, transformation staging, consumption fanout.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json, os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Color system ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CAT = {
    "IoT/Streaming": "#156082", "Enterprise Apps": "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream": "#0D4A66", "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases": "#1E7099",
}
LAYER = {"ingestion": "#5A6B7D", "bronze": "#B8732E", "silver": "#8595A8",
         "gold": "#C4932E", "consumption": "#27754C"}
CON = {"BI": "#277540", "ML": "#773B70", "API": "#1E7099", "Reverse ETL": "#C4932E"}
EDGE = {"streaming": "#27AE60", "batch": "#E67E22", "cdc": "#9B59B6", "query": "#AAAAAA"}
GOV = {"automated": "#27AE60", "policy-based": "#E67E22", "manual": "#E74C3C", "scheduled": "#3498DB"}

# ── Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(30, 18), facecolor="#F5F6F8")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.025, 0.12, 0.95, 0.78])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.0); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.0); ax.axis("off")

layers = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
L_X = {ly: 0.035 + i * 0.186 for i, ly in enumerate(layers)}

# ── Node ordering & positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SOURCE_ORDER = ["src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_nosql", "src_crm", "src_files",
    "src_social", "src_market"]
INGEST_ORDER = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
BRONZE_ORDER = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
SILVER_ORDER = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
GOLD_ORDER   = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
                "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
CONS_ORDER   = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

ORDERS = {"source": SOURCE_ORDER, "ingestion": INGEST_ORDER,
    "bronze": BRONZE_ORDER, "silver": SILVER_ORDER,
    "gold": GOLD_ORDER, "consumption": CONS_ORDER}

y_pos = {}
for ly in layers:
    order = ORDERS[ly]; n = len(order)
    sp = 0.84 / (n - 1) if n > 1 else 0
    for i, nid in enumerate(order):
        y_pos[nid] = 0.92 - i * sp

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def nc(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source": return CAT.get(n["category"], "#888")
    if n["layer"] == "consumption": return CON.get(n["category"], LAYER[n["layer"]])
    return LAYER.get(n["layer"], "#999")

def hrgba(h, a):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return (int(h[0:2],16)/255, int(h[2:4],16)/255, int(h[4:6],16)/255, a)

vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
VMAX = max(vols)
def lw(v):
    if v is None: return 0.5
    return 0.5 + np.sqrt(v/VMAX) * 17.5

# ── Governance by layer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gov_by = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

# ── Transformation summary by layer ────────────────────────────────────────
txf = {}
for t in transforms:
    txf.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0})
    txf[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    txf[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE BACKGROUND PANEL (top of each layer column)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    xc = L_X[ly]; bw = 0.074
    # Background panel
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xc - bw, 0.958), bw * 2, 0.042,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.005", facecolor="#ECEEF1",
        edgecolor="#D5D8DC", linewidth=0.7, zorder=3))
    # Enforcement indicator dots
    if ly in gov_by:
        items = gov_by[ly]
        for i, g in enumerate(items):
            dot_x = xc - bw * 0.85 + i * (bw * 1.7 / max(len(items)-1, 1)) if len(items) > 1 else xc
            ax.scatter(dot_x, 0.978, s=38, color=GOV.get(g["enforcement"], "#999"),
                      edgecolors="white", linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
        # Count label
        n_auto = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "automated")
        n_pol  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "policy-based")
        n_man  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "manual")
        n_sch  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "scheduled")
        ax.text(xc, 0.962, f"⬤{n_auto} ⬤{n_pol} ⬤{n_man} ⬤{n_sch}",
               fontsize=4.2, ha="center", color="#888", zorder=5)

ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.15, 0.010), 0.70, 0.020, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
    facecolor="#ECEEF1", edgecolor="#D5D8DC", linewidth=0.6, zorder=3))

cross_ctrls = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
cross_txt = "  ◆  ".join(f"{g['control_type']} [{g['tool']}]" for g in cross_ctrls)
ax.text(0.50, 0.020, f"CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:  {cross_txt}",
       fontsize=5.8, ha="center", va="center", color="#555")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EDGES — Bezier curves layered by mode
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mode_priority = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}
for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = sorted(
        [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode],
        key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0
    )
    for e in mode_edges:
        s, t = id_to_node[e["source"]], id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0, y0_ = L_X[s["layer"]] + 0.042, y_pos[e["source"]]
        x1, y1_ = L_X[t["layer"]] - 0.042, y_pos[e["target"]]
        w = lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = EDGE.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        al = 0.42 if mode == "query" else 0.55

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1-x0)*0.38, y0_)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1-x0)*0.38, y1_)
        verts = [(x0, y0_), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1_)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        p = mpatches.PathPatch(Path(verts, codes), facecolor="none",
            edgecolor=ec, linewidth=w, alpha=al, zorder=10+mode_priority[mode],
            capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NW, NH = 0.047, 0.032

ABBREV = {
    "Application Logs": "App Logs", "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
    "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs", "Market Data Feeds": "Market Data",
    "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB", "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
    "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares", "ERP System": "ERP",
    "CRM Platform": "CRM", "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
    "Batch Ingestion": "Batch Ingest", "Stream Ingestion": "Stream Ingest",
    "Raw IoT Events": "Raw IoT", "Raw Transactions": "Raw Txn",
    "Raw Log Data": "Raw Logs", "Raw External Data": "Raw External",
    "Raw DB Snapshots": "Raw DB Snap", "Cleaned IoT Metrics": "Clean IoT",
    "Unified Customer 360": "Customer 360", "Sessionized Clickstream": "Sess. Clicks",
    "Enriched Transactions": "Enriched Txn", "Normalized Market Data": "Norm. Market",
    "Revenue Aggregates": "Revenue Agg", "Customer LTV Scores": "Customer LTV",
    "Anomaly Detection Features": "Anomaly Feat.", "Product Performance KPIs": "Product KPIs",
    "Marketing Attribution": "Marketing Attr", "Executive Dashboards": "Exec Dashboards",
    "Ad-hoc SQL Analytics": "Ad-hoc SQL", "ML Training Pipelines": "ML Training",
    "ML Serving Endpoints": "ML Serving", "Data API Services": "Data API",
    "Reverse ETL to SaaS": "Reverse ETL",
}

for n in nodes_data:
    xc, yc = L_X[n["layer"]], y_pos[n["node_id"]]
    x0r, y0r = xc - NW/2, yc - NH/2
    col = nc(n)

    # Shadow + main node
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0r+0.002, y0r-0.002), NW, NH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000018", edgecolor="none", zorder=19))
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0r, y0r), NW, NH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.8, zorder=20))

    label = ABBREV.get(n["label"], n["label"])
    if len(label) > 14:
        label = label[:13] + "…"

    ax.text(xc, yc+0.001, label, ha="center", va="center",
           fontsize=5.4, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=21,
           path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground="#00000044")])

    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax.text(xc, yc - NH/2 - 0.007, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",
               ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.0, color="#777", zorder=21)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SOURCE CATEGORY GROUP BRACKETS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SRC_GRP = {
    "IoT/Streaming": ["src_iot"],
    "Logs/Clickstream": ["src_logs", "src_clickstream"],
    "Enterprise Apps": ["src_erp", "src_crm", "src_files"],
    "Databases": ["src_rdbms", "src_nosql"],
    "External/3rd Party": ["src_social", "src_market"],
}
CAT_ORDER = ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
             "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]

for cat in CAT_ORDER:
    nids = SRC_GRP[cat]
    top = max(y_pos[n] for n in nids) + NH/2 + 0.005
    bot = min(y_pos[n] for n in nids) - NH/2 - 0.005
    ax.plot([0.008, 0.008], [bot, top], color=CAT[cat], linewidth=3.5,
           alpha=0.55, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=6)
    my = (top + bot) / 2
    ax.text(0.006, my, cat, fontsize=5.8, ha="right", va="center",
           color=CAT[cat], fontweight="bold", zorder=22)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HEADERS = [
    ("DATA SOURCES\n5 Categories · 1,560 GB/day", L_X["source"], "#156082"),
    ("INGESTION\n3 Engines · 1,560 GB/day",     L_X["ingestion"], "#5A6B7D"),
    ("BRONZE — Raw\n5 Landing Zones · 1,560 GB", L_X["bronze"], "#B8732E"),
    ("SILVER — Curated\n5 Datasets · 445 GB",    L_X["silver"], "#8595A8"),
    ("GOLD — Business\n5 Datasets · 32 GB",      L_X["gold"], "#C4932E"),
    ("CONSUMPTION\n6 Endpoint Types",            L_X["consumption"], "#27754C"),
]
for label, xc, col in HEADERS:
    ax.text(xc, 1.006, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5,

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

           f"Low: {info.get('L',0)}   Med: {info.get('M',0)}   High: {info.get('H',0)}")

    ("Flow Mode", EDGE),
    ("Governance", GOV),
]
lx = 0.035
for title, cmap in leg_sections:
    ax.text(lx, leg_y, f"{title}:", fontsize=5.5, ha="left", va="center",
           color="#444", fontweight="bold")
    lx += 0.058
    for name, col in cmap.items():
        ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(

            boxstyle="round,pad=0.001", facecolor=col, edgecolor="none", zorder=25))
        ax.text(lx+0.013, leg_y, name, fontsize=5.0, ha="left", va="center", color="#666")
        lx += 0.05
    lx += 0.026

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE LEGEND NOTE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# List governance controls per layer in the subtitle area
gov_lines = []
for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    if ly in gov_by:
        names = [g["control_type"] for g in gov_by[ly]]
        ly_short = {"ingestion": "ING", "bronze": "BRZ", "silver": "SLV",
                    "gold": "GLD", "consumption": "CON"}[ly]
        gov_lines.append(f"{ly_short}: {', '.join(names)}")

fig.text(0.5, 0.086,
         "GOVERNANCE BY LAYER:  " + "  ║  ".join(gov_lines),
         ha="center", fontsize=5.2, color="#777", family="monospace")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Data Pipeline & Governance",
            fontsize=21, fontweight="bold", color="#1a1a1a", y=0.994)
fig.text(0.5, 0.978,
         "10 Sources  →  3 Ingestion Engines  →  5 Bronze / 5 Silver / 5 Gold Medallion Datasets  →  6 Consumption Endpoints  |  "
         "Volume-Weighted Flow Paths  |  15 Cross-Cutting Governance Controls",
         ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#888", style="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXPORT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=200, facecolor="#F5F6F8",
            edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close(fig)
print("Saved: /app/output/result.png")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Data Lakehouse Architecture — Professional Sankey Flow Diagram.

Complete data pipeline: 10 sources → ingestion → Bronze/Silver/Gold → 6 consumption endpoints.
Volume-weighted edges, governance overlay, transformation staging, consumption fanout.
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.path import Path
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np
import json, os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
nodes_data = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges_data = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]
id_to_node = {n["node_id"]: n for n in nodes_data}

# ── Color system ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CAT = {
    "IoT/Streaming": "#156082", "Enterprise Apps": "#2E86AB",
    "Logs/Clickstream": "#0D4A66", "External/3rd Party": "#4A9DB5",
    "Databases": "#1E7099",
}
LAYER = {"ingestion": "#5A6B7D", "bronze": "#B8732E", "silver": "#8595A8",
         "gold": "#C4932E", "consumption": "#27754C"}
CON = {"BI": "#277540", "ML": "#773B70", "API": "#1E7099", "Reverse ETL": "#C4932E"}
EDGE = {"streaming": "#27AE60", "batch": "#E67E22", "cdc": "#9B59B6", "query": "#AAAAAA"}
GOV = {"automated": "#27AE60", "policy-based": "#E67E22", "manual": "#E74C3C", "scheduled": "#3498DB"}

# ── Layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(30, 18), facecolor="#F5F6F8")
ax = fig.add_axes([0.025, 0.12, 0.95, 0.78])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.0); ax.set_ylim(0, 1.0); ax.axis("off")

layers = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
L_X = {ly: 0.035 + i * 0.186 for i, ly in enumerate(layers)}

# ── Node ordering & positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
SOURCE_ORDER = ["src_iot", "src_logs", "src_clickstream",
    "src_erp", "src_rdbms", "src_nosql", "src_crm", "src_files",
    "src_social", "src_market"]
INGEST_ORDER = ["ing_stream", "ing_batch", "ing_cdc"]
BRONZE_ORDER = ["brz_raw_logs", "brz_raw_iot", "brz_raw_txn", "brz_raw_db", "brz_raw_ext"]
SILVER_ORDER = ["slv_cleaned_iot", "slv_enriched_txn", "slv_sessionized_clicks",
                "slv_unified_customer", "slv_normalized_market"]
GOLD_ORDER   = ["gld_anomaly_features", "gld_revenue_agg", "gld_product_perf",
                "gld_marketing_attr", "gld_customer_ltv"]
CONS_ORDER   = ["con_dashboard", "con_adhoc", "con_ml_train", "con_ml_serve",
                "con_data_api", "con_reverse_etl"]

ORDERS = {"source": SOURCE_ORDER, "ingestion": INGEST_ORDER,
    "bronze": BRONZE_ORDER, "silver": SILVER_ORDER,
    "gold": GOLD_ORDER, "consumption": CONS_ORDER}

y_pos = {}
for ly in layers:
    order = ORDERS[ly]; n = len(order)
    sp = 0.84 / (n - 1) if n > 1 else 0
    for i, nid in enumerate(order):
        y_pos[nid] = 0.92 - i * sp

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def nc(n):
    if n["layer"] == "source": return CAT.get(n["category"], "#888")
    if n["layer"] == "consumption": return CON.get(n["category"], LAYER[n["layer"]])
    return LAYER.get(n["layer"], "#999")

def hrgba(h, a):
    h = h.lstrip("#")
    return (int(h[0:2],16)/255, int(h[2:4],16)/255, int(h[4:6],16)/255, a)

vols = [e["volume_gb"] for e in edges_data if e["volume_gb"] is not None]
VMAX = max(vols)
def lw(v):
    if v is None: return 0.5
    return 0.5 + np.sqrt(v/VMAX) * 17.5

# ── Governance by layer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gov_by = {}
for g in governance:
    gov_by.setdefault(g["layer"], []).append(g)

# ── Transformation summary by layer ────────────────────────────────────────
txf = {}
for t in transforms:
    txf.setdefault(t["layer"], {"total": 0, "L": 0, "M": 0, "H": 0})
    txf[t["layer"]]["total"] += t["count"]
    txf[t["layer"]][t["complexity"][0].upper()] += t["count"]

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE BACKGROUND PANEL (top of each layer column)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    xc = L_X[ly]; bw = 0.074
    # Background panel
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (xc - bw, 0.958), bw * 2, 0.042,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.005", facecolor="#ECEEF1",
        edgecolor="#D5D8DC", linewidth=0.7, zorder=3))
    # Enforcement indicator dots
    if ly in gov_by:
        items = gov_by[ly]
        for i, g in enumerate(items):
            dot_x = xc - bw * 0.85 + i * (bw * 1.7 / max(len(items)-1, 1)) if len(items) > 1 else xc
            ax.scatter(dot_x, 0.978, s=38, color=GOV.get(g["enforcement"], "#999"),
                      edgecolors="white", linewidth=0.5, zorder=4)
        # Count label
        n_auto = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "automated")
        n_pol  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "policy-based")
        n_man  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "manual")
        n_sch  = sum(1 for g in items if g["enforcement"] == "scheduled")
        ax.text(xc, 0.962, f"⬤{n_auto} ⬤{n_pol} ⬤{n_man} ⬤{n_sch}",
               fontsize=4.2, ha="center", color="#888", zorder=5)

ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
    (0.15, 0.010), 0.70, 0.020, boxstyle="round,pad=0.004",
    facecolor="#ECEEF1", edgecolor="#D5D8DC", linewidth=0.6, zorder=3))

cross_ctrls = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
cross_txt = "  ◆  ".join(f"{g['control_type']} [{g['tool']}]" for g in cross_ctrls)
ax.text(0.50, 0.020, f"CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:  {cross_txt}",
       fontsize=5.8, ha="center", va="center", color="#555")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EDGES — Bezier curves layered by mode
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mode_priority = {"query": 0, "batch": 1, "cdc": 2, "streaming": 3}
for mode in ["query", "batch", "cdc", "streaming"]:
    mode_edges = sorted(
        [e for e in edges_data if e["mode"] == mode],
        key=lambda e: e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 0
    )
    for e in mode_edges:
        s, t = id_to_node[e["source"]], id_to_node[e["target"]]
        x0, y0_ = L_X[s["layer"]] + 0.042, y_pos[e["source"]]
        x1, y1_ = L_X[t["layer"]] - 0.042, y_pos[e["target"]]
        w = lw(e["volume_gb"])
        ec = EDGE.get(e["mode"], "#999")
        al = 0.42 if mode == "query" else 0.55

        cp1 = (x0 + (x1-x0)*0.38, y0_)
        cp2 = (x1 - (x1-x0)*0.38, y1_)
        verts = [(x0, y0_), cp1, cp2, (x1, y1_)]
        codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
        p = mpatches.PathPatch(Path(verts, codes), facecolor="none",
            edgecolor=ec, linewidth=w, alpha=al, zorder=10+mode_priority[mode],
            capstyle="round", joinstyle="round")
        ax.add_patch(p)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NW, NH = 0.047, 0.032

ABBREV = {
    "Application Logs": "App Logs", "Web Clickstream": "Clickstream",
    "Social Media APIs": "Social APIs", "Market Data Feeds": "Market Data",
    "Legacy RDBMS": "Legacy DB", "NoSQL Stores": "NoSQL",
    "File Shares (SFTP)": "File Shares", "ERP System": "ERP",
    "CRM Platform": "CRM", "IoT Sensors": "IoT Sensors",
    "Batch Ingestion": "Batch Ingest", "Stream Ingestion": "Stream Ingest",
    "Raw IoT Events": "Raw IoT", "Raw Transactions": "Raw Txn",
    "Raw Log Data": "Raw Logs", "Raw External Data": "Raw External",
    "Raw DB Snapshots": "Raw DB Snap", "Cleaned IoT Metrics": "Clean IoT",
    "Unified Customer 360": "Customer 360", "Sessionized Clickstream": "Sess. Clicks",
    "Enriched Transactions": "Enriched Txn", "Normalized Market Data": "Norm. Market",
    "Revenue Aggregates": "Revenue Agg", "Customer LTV Scores": "Customer LTV",
    "Anomaly Detection Features": "Anomaly Feat.", "Product Performance KPIs": "Product KPIs",
    "Marketing Attribution": "Marketing Attr", "Executive Dashboards": "Exec Dashboards",
    "Ad-hoc SQL Analytics": "Ad-hoc SQL", "ML Training Pipelines": "ML Training",
    "ML Serving Endpoints": "ML Serving", "Data API Services": "Data API",
    "Reverse ETL to SaaS": "Reverse ETL",
}

for n in nodes_data:
    xc, yc = L_X[n["layer"]], y_pos[n["node_id"]]
    x0r, y0r = xc - NW/2, yc - NH/2
    col = nc(n)

    # Shadow + main node
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0r+0.002, y0r-0.002), NW, NH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor="#00000018", edgecolor="none", zorder=19))
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x0r, y0r), NW, NH,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.004", facecolor=col,
        edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.8, zorder=20))

    label = ABBREV.get(n["label"], n["label"])
    if len(label) > 14:
        label = label[:13] + "…"

    ax.text(xc, yc+0.001, label, ha="center", va="center",
           fontsize=5.4, fontweight="bold", color="white", zorder=21,
           path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground="#00000044")])

    if n["daily_volume_gb"] is not None:
        ax.text(xc, yc - NH/2 - 0.007, f"{n['daily_volume_gb']} GB",
               ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.0, color="#777", zorder=21)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SOURCE CATEGORY GROUP BRACKETS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SRC_GRP = {
    "IoT/Streaming": ["src_iot"],
    "Logs/Clickstream": ["src_logs", "src_clickstream"],
    "Enterprise Apps": ["src_erp", "src_crm", "src_files"],
    "Databases": ["src_rdbms", "src_nosql"],
    "External/3rd Party": ["src_social", "src_market"],
}
CAT_ORDER = ["IoT/Streaming", "Logs/Clickstream", "Enterprise Apps",
             "Databases", "External/3rd Party"]

for cat in CAT_ORDER:
    nids = SRC_GRP[cat]
    top = max(y_pos[n] for n in nids) + NH/2 + 0.005
    bot = min(y_pos[n] for n in nids) - NH/2 - 0.005
    ax.plot([0.008, 0.008], [bot, top], color=CAT[cat], linewidth=3.5,
           alpha=0.55, solid_capstyle="round", zorder=6)
    my = (top + bot) / 2
    ax.text(0.006, my, cat, fontsize=5.8, ha="right", va="center",
           color=CAT[cat], fontweight="bold", zorder=22)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LAYER HEADERS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HEADERS = [
    ("DATA SOURCES\n5 Categories · 1,560 GB/day", L_X["source"], "#156082"),
    ("INGESTION\n3 Engines · 1,560 GB/day",     L_X["ingestion"], "#5A6B7D"),
    ("BRONZE — Raw\n5 Landing Zones · 1,560 GB", L_X["bronze"], "#B8732E"),
    ("SILVER — Curated\n5 Datasets · 445 GB",    L_X["silver"], "#8595A8"),
    ("GOLD — Business\n5 Datasets · 32 GB",      L_X["gold"], "#C4932E"),
    ("CONSUMPTION\n6 Endpoint Types",            L_X["consumption"], "#27754C"),
]
for label, xc, col in HEADERS:
    ax.text(xc, 1.006, label, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7.5,
           fontweight="bold", color=col, family="monospace", linespacing=1.25)
    ax.plot([xc-0.036, xc+0.036], [0.998, 0.998], color=col,
           linewidth=4, solid_capstyle="round")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TRANSFORMATION CALLOUTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
for ly in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    info = txf.get(ly)
    if not info: continue
    xc = L_X[ly]
    txt = (f"TRANSFORMS: {info['total']} total\n"
           f"Low: {info.get('L',0)}   Med: {info.get('M',0)}   High: {info.get('H',0)}")
    ax.text(xc, 0.035, txt, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=5.0,
           color="#444", family="monospace",
           bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.45", facecolor="white",
                    edgecolor="#CCC", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.92), zorder=23)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# VOLUME SCALE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sx = 0.93
ax.text(sx+0.017, 0.94, "VOLUME\nSCALE", fontsize=5.8, ha="center",
       va="bottom", color="#999", fontweight="bold")
for i, (v, lb) in enumerate([(530, "530 GB"), (200, "200 GB"), (50, "50 GB"), (5, "5 GB")]):
    sy = 0.86 - i * 0.07
    ax.plot([sx, sx+0.032], [sy, sy], color="#888", linewidth=lw(v),
           alpha=0.5, solid_capstyle="round")
    ax.text(sx+0.036, sy, lb, fontsize=4.8, color="#888", va="center")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BOTTOM LEGEND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
leg_y = 0.075
leg_sections = [
    ("Source", CAT),
    ("Medallion", {"Bronze": "#B8732E", "Silver": "#8595A8", "Gold": "#C4932E"}),
    ("Consumption", CON),
    ("Flow Mode", EDGE),
    ("Governance", GOV),
]
lx = 0.035
for title, cmap in leg_sections:
    ax.text(lx, leg_y, f"{title}:", fontsize=5.5, ha="left", va="center",
           color="#444", fontweight="bold")
    lx += 0.058
    for name, col in cmap.items():
        ax.add_patch(mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
            (lx, leg_y-0.004), 0.010, 0.008,
            boxstyle="round,pad=0.001", facecolor=col, edgecolor="none", zorder=25))
        ax.text(lx+0.013, leg_y, name, fontsize=5.0, ha="left", va="center", color="#666")
        lx += 0.05
    lx += 0.026

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GOVERNANCE LEGEND NOTE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# List governance controls per layer in the subtitle area
gov_lines = []
for ly in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    if ly in gov_by:
        names = [g["control_type"] for g in gov_by[ly]]
        ly_short = {"ingestion": "ING", "bronze": "BRZ", "silver": "SLV",
                    "gold": "GLD", "consumption": "CON"}[ly]
        gov_lines.append(f"{ly_short}: {', '.join(names)}")

fig.text(0.5, 0.086,
         "GOVERNANCE BY LAYER:  " + "  ║  ".join(gov_lines),
         ha="center", fontsize=5.2, color="#777", family="monospace")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Data Pipeline & Governance",
            fontsize=21, fontweight="bold", color="#1a1a1a", y=0.994)
fig.text(0.5, 0.978,
         "10 Sources  →  3 Ingestion Engines  →  5 Bronze / 5 Silver / 5 Gold Medallion Datasets  →  6 Consumption Endpoints  |  "
         "Volume-Weighted Flow Paths  |  15 Cross-Cutting Governance Controls",
         ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#888", style="italic")

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# EXPORT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=200, facecolor="#F5F6F8",
            edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight", pad_inches=0.3)
plt.close(fig)
print("Saved: /app/output/result.png")
